tool.name: MLflow
tool.description: Open-source AI engineering platform with OpenTelemetry-compatible GenAI tracing, LLM-judge evaluation, prompt registry and AI gateway.
strengths: Managed on Databricks, SageMaker and Azure ML
tool.pricing: Free and open source. Trace data stays on your own infrastructure. Managed hosting is billed by the cloud provider.
tool.logoNotes: Fallback: no reviewed logo asset sourced yet.
tool.practitionerNote: The natural choice for teams already running MLflow for classic ML, since GenAI traces, evals and prompts sit beside existing experiments and models. Upgrade self-hosted servers to 3.16.1 or later, which removed a default basic-auth admin password.

dataResidency.detail: Self-hosted: trace data is stored on the operator's own infrastructure. Managed variants follow the hosting cloud's region.

deployment.detail: Self-hosted OSS server, or managed through Databricks, AWS SageMaker, Azure Machine Learning or Red Hat OpenShift AI.

auditLogging.detail: The GenAI docs describe trace capture but not a native user or admin audit log for the OSS server. Managed platforms may add their own.

soc2.detail: Self-hosted open-source software. SOC 2 applies to the operator or the managed-service provider, not the package.

iso27001.detail: Self-hosted open-source software. ISO 27001 applies to the operator's ISMS, not the package.

iso42001.detail: Self-hosted open-source software. ISO 42001 applies to the deploying organisation.

euAiAct.detail: Developer and observability tooling, not an AI system placed on the market. Obligations rest with the deployer.
